requirement_summary: Certificate and Product Assurance Final Ceiling: Product-level Certificate 발급은 exact CompositionSnapshot, current FinalLock, required independent verification, current qualification/authority, scope 내 unresolved P0 blocker 0, 그리고 요구 Assurance Level이 production-bound이면 Verified-to-Deployed-to-Running Currentness가 모두 닫혀야 한다. 하나라도 UNKNOWN/HOLD이면 positive Certificate 발급을 금지한다.
subject: src/main/java/kr/co/oruda/onsure/platform/SemanticAssuranceV2WorkflowService.java (certificateIssue), assurance.certificate.issue v2 operation
observed_source: SemanticAssuranceV2DispatcherBridgeTest (real dispatch, real Ed25519 signature verification)
coverage_notes: The requirement's core fail-closed rule -- 'any one of the required closures being UNKNOWN/HOLD forbids a positive Certificate' -- is genuinely, unconditionally implemented: currentness_state_at_issue is hardcoded UNKNOWN (CERTIFICATE_CURRENTNESS_VERIFIER_NOT_WIRED is disclosed in limitation_summary on every issuance), so even when composition_decision=PASS, the certificate's own decision is forced to HOLD, never a positive claim. A non-PASS composition_decision forces BLOCKED. Every certificate is Ed25519-signed with every field (including limitation_summary and final_claim_allowed=false) inside the signed payload, verified against its own embedded public key.
open_gap: The requirement also names composition_snapshot_digest, final_lock_digest, and 'current qualification/authority' as inputs that must be 'exact'/'current' -- certificateIssue accepts these as caller-supplied digests (format-validated as real sha256 strings) but does not itself independently verify they are the CURRENT/exact values (e.g. cross-checking composition_snapshot_digest against a live CompositionSnapshot store, or final_lock_digest against an actual current FinalLock record). The unconditional-HOLD behavior above makes this gap non-exploitable for a positive claim today (nothing can reach PASS regardless), but the requirement's full scope -- validating the SUPPLIED digests are genuinely current, not just well-formed -- is not yet independently covered.
design_reference_gap: REQUIREMENT_WITHOUT_DESIGN remains: the trace scanner correctly excludes FR-META-060's own authority document (02_FUNCTIONAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_PROGRAMS.md) as circular, and no other design document currently cites FR-META-060 by ID -- a genuine gap, disclosed rather than papered over.
